mapper.select: SELECT chat_feedback_no, message_no, rating, comment, comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version, frst_reg_dt, ip_hash FROM tb_chat_feedback WHERE message_no = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_feedback ( message_no, rating, comment, comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version, ip_hash ) VALUES ( #{messageNo}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{commentCiphertext}, #{commentKeyId}, #{commentEncryptionVersion}, #{ipHash} ) ON CONFLICT (message_no) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, comment = EXCLUDED.comment, comment_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id = EXCLUDED.comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version = EXCLUDED.comment_encryption_version, ip_hash = EXCLUDED.ip_hash
mapper.select: SELECT chat_feedback_no AS id, comment AS plaintext, comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, comment_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_feedback WHERE comment_ciphertext IS NULL AND comment IS NOT NULL AND comment != '' AND comment != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY chat_feedback_no LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT chat_feedback_no AS id, comment AS plaintext, comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, comment_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_feedback WHERE comment_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND comment_key_id IS NOT NULL AND comment_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY chat_feedback_no LIMIT #{limit}
